articles.headline: Microsoft expands Azure capacity in the United States
articles.summary: Microsoft announced additional Azure cloud capacity.
articles.body: Microsoft announced an expansion of Azure cloud capacity in several United States regions. The announcement concerns Microsoft-operated Azure infrastructure and does not involve Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud or Meta infrastructure.

articles.headline: Earthquake strikes Japan with no major industrial disruption reported
articles.summary: An earthquake struck Japan but authorities reported no major infrastructure or industrial disruption.
articles.body: An earthquake struck Japan on Friday. Authorities said transportation systems remained operational and there were no reports of major factory shutdowns, port closures or power disruptions.

articles.headline: Port disruption in Taiwan delays consumer goods shipments
articles.summary: A temporary port disruption delayed consumer goods shipments.
articles.body: A temporary port disruption in Taiwan delayed shipments of clothing and household consumer goods. The report did not mention semiconductor products, electronics manufacturing or technology companies.

articles.headline: Google announces new AI model
articles.summary: Google introduced a new artificial intelligence model.
articles.body: Google announced a new artificial intelligence model designed for enterprise applications. The launch is a Google product announcement and does not describe NVIDIA supply problems, semiconductor shortages or datacenter outages.

articles.headline: TSMC reports temporary production interruption in Taiwan
articles.summary: TSMC temporarily interrupted chip production after an equipment issue.
articles.body: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company temporarily interrupted production at a Taiwan facility following an equipment issue. The affected operation produces advanced semiconductor chips used by external customers. TSMC said production restoration work was underway.

articles.headline: Amazon opens new retail distribution center in Texas
articles.summary: Amazon opened a new ecommerce distribution center.
articles.body: Amazon opened a new retail distribution center in Texas to support ecommerce deliveries. The facility is part of Amazon's retail logistics network and is unrelated to AWS cloud infrastructure.

articles.headline: China introduces new rules for online advertising platforms
articles.summary: Chinese regulators announced new rules governing online advertising platforms.
articles.body: Chinese regulators introduced new requirements for digital advertising platforms operating in China. The rules cover advertising disclosures and platform compliance. No individual US technology company was named.

articles.headline: Tesla CEO comments on long-term electric vehicle demand
articles.summary: Tesla's CEO discussed his expectations for future electric vehicle demand.
articles.body: Tesla's chief executive discussed long-term electric vehicle demand during an interview. No factory shutdown, financing action, earnings announcement, regulatory decision or discrete operational event was announced.
